# Controller custody qualification preparation — 2026-09-14

Prepare a separate guarded controller-only instrument after root accepts the
complete custody source and fixture verdict. The original 95-case observations
at `fc17b67` remain unchanged. Do not rerun them for documentation or substitute
new core modules into their older isolated fixture family.

The proposed unit contains ten controller cases with 104 planned subtest
iterations. These are source counts, not results. Select the final durable source
`ce69903d93daf41ae3717008f8d0dbd0b3ead7b11662b674eddf43828567b222`, adapter
`227395c4e1f25f75f13dc950e3b2e222af4a4d8b307a36091908229b58ed0c0f`, fixture
`63642115cf53a21911ea8fd1e31af91ff20c2807639e39dab5ec23fce94c06f7` and tests
`061b7eb77db2ee834b54d790012fe280b1e1ac82e82dfb289681e926adbbec8d`.
Verify their final source maps and unchanged source-ordered EXPECTED-CASES list.
Any subsequent source change requires a new reviewed binding before preparation.

Use exactly nine canonical modules: trusted_asr_resolver, snapshot_lifecycle,
snapshot_reservations, reservation_file_port, durable_lifecycle,
asr_loading_adapter, test_reservations, controller_boundary_fixture and
test_controller_resume_publication. The fixture map supplies the five unchanged
donors. Load the repaired pair under their actual import names in one fixed
family; preserve their function-local reverse import. No alias substitution,
dynamic module discovery, permissive import fallback or positive validator
replacement belongs in this instrument.

The reviewed stage95 instrument is a donor for guard mechanics only:
`docs/library/proof/controller-stage-fake95-2026-09-14` preserves the qualification
proposal and copies. Its qualifier is `qualify_windows_reservations.py`, SHA256
`6eafdbd476026a3b01750d6abfb6c4d429078eea766410fc9a2803f7f9c3c846`; launcher
`run_preflight01.ps1` is
`b71b436882df599c0650220383ed338f745345e19ca4217c9be1fe18eacf8930`.
The local donor is `_scratch/controller-stage-qualification-proposal01`, parent
map `b831bf6c864d8a7bef24355e5868dfa7480e6bba6ff1381cbc3ac9db07388606`.
Read its complete qualifier, launcher and protocol before deriving anything.
Keep immutable before copies and exact mechanical diffs with declared reasons.

Create a fresh `_scratch/controller-custody-qualification-proposal01`. Preserve
the existing protection against filesystem/native/model/network activity,
metadata and module-registry substitution, disallowed imports and real authority
activation. Bind the nine-module content and the finite new function/type/anchor
set before cases run. Negative tests temporarily replace helpers to prove refusal;
they must restore them, and must never replace positive authority. Retained failed
inert custody is expected evidence, not permission to clear a reservation.

The only intended changes from the donor instrument are this smaller canonical
family, its exact fixtures/cases, fixed guard captures, hashes and fresh labels.
Preserve stdout/stderr capture, original child status and full per-case/subtest
objects. No truncated preview, an outer exit alone or a report may stand in for
those observations. Freeze input/output membership and verify hashes before and
after each invocation. Keep all original failed delivery, draft and passive
checker observations intact.

Preparation is source-only: no Python startup, import, compile or candidate
execution, and no generated harness smoke test. Root and an independent reviewer
must inspect the complete final instrument and both concrete copies first.
Root then records an exact admission separately for each fresh run. Author and
confirmation copies must have identical subject bytes and case IDs; only
explicit fixed run-label/path differences are allowed in their parent controls.
An admission for one copy does not authorize a second or a rerun.

Any later admitted host is `C:\Python314\python.exe -I -S -B` with the lexical
`IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE` value set before startup. Never use ambient or staged Python,
touch the live index, contact port 5179, access D1/D2/model/support artifacts or a
physical journal, fetch data, spend paid API or invoke native/real model services.
No production, installation, package, website or marketing changes.

Root must review the complete results and counts from both copies, then archive
and integrate through raw worktree diff and checkout three-way apply, verify every
proof payload against Git and disk, and update the handoff. A failure remains a
failure; a further invocation needs its documented repair and a fresh brief.
Accepted assertions cannot be changed to obtain a pass.

Even a passing controller unit leaves full latest generated-start compatibility
required. Its separate 28-module family includes the strict owned contender;
partial gate-reach/refusal probes do not replace its successful-start observation.
Authenticated child transport, real startup/model authority, the complete tree,
candidate build, installation and market review remain later gates.

Prepare one controller-only instrument after root authorizes the source and fixture checkpoint. Reuse the stage95 qualifier and launcher bound in SOURCE-INPUTS.json. This plan contains no generated harness, admission or execution. The prior stage95 qualification remains historical evidence; this ten-case unit does not rerun those cases.

Load the nine canonical modules in the fixture map's exact order: trusted_asr_resolver, snapshot_lifecycle, snapshot_reservations, reservation_file_port, durable_lifecycle, asr_loading_adapter, test_reservations, controller_boundary_fixture, then test_controller_resume_publication. The first four have no subject-module imports. Durable loads after both lifecycle and reservations; its function-local reverse import resolves the already loaded canonical adapter when the factory later runs. The dormant generated_adapter_flow imports remain unavailable. Do not add that generated family or introduce an import fallback.

Use the exact ten ordered IDs and unchanged EXPECTED bytes recorded in SOURCE-INPUTS.json. Only those ten methods are selected through the donor's explicit LOADED-module lookup. test_reservations supplies the inherited inert services; its own cases are not selected. Proposed subtest counts in order are 0, 26, 4, 4, 48, 4, 4, 4, 8 and 2: total 104, maximum 48. These source declarations fit the unchanged limit of 64 per case and are not observed results.

Replace the donor's two-family alias block with one canonical-family check. Capture the fixed function, method, type and anchor references listed in SOURCE-INPUTS.json after the six subject modules load, before test_reservations definitions. Keep the donor's captured validator identity and entry-valid flag. Retain the exact 19-entry controller tuple and its member identities, the durable factory-check anchor, original custody/attempt types and imported type relationships. Capture the resolver's three lower metadata hooks because the fixture temporarily replaces them and must restore them. Do not obtain expected references from the test module or recapture them after cases. Failed inert custody is deliberately retained; an empty registry is not an acceptance condition.

Preserve these ten guard fields verbatim:

| Guard | Required adaptation |
| --- | --- |
| startup_bound | Same isolated flags and lexical forbidden-path binding. |
| content_reads_closed | Same fixed text-read set and closed content stage. |
| audit_identity_unchanged | Same installed audit reference. |
| metadata_traps_installed | Same 12 metadata callable identities. |
| baseline_winreg_identity_unchanged | Same permitted startup winreg module identity. |
| registry_namespace_unchanged | Same complete saved namespace comparison. |
| registry_traps_installed | Same bounded callable traps; retain actual count. |
| captures_installed | Same stdout/stderr capture identities. |
| capture_valid | Same empty captures and 8192-character limits. |
| real_entrypoints_unchanged | Canonical module/function/type/anchor checks and absent configured authority before test definitions and after cases. |

For the last guard, retain real_journal_port and real_reservation_service identities plus the fixed adapter real-start refusal. The two omitted native modules have no entries to capture; they stay outside the permitted import set. This is an explicit closure reduction, not evidence about their runtime behavior. The fixture's temporary generated approval and metadata services are bounded by its existing context and restoration; no real approval is supplied.

Leave the stdlib preloads, early registry block, audit denials, heavy-root set, metadata traps, Results methods, selector, serialization and exit recording unchanged. Change only fixed module/case lists, canonical captures, counts, scope labels and pins. Keep the 1 MiB child-text, 8192-character capture and 262144-byte result limits. Preserve all fixture and case bytes.

The future parent map has 15 entries: nine modules, qualifier, EXPECTED, launcher, BRIEF, protocol and SOURCE-INPUTS. The child reads 11 texts. A successful run contains those 15 copied entries, PINS.json, ROOT-ADMISSION.json and six receipts: plan.json, stdout.json, stderr.log, native-exit.json, input-check.json and exit.json—23 files. Preserve launch-failure.json when actually written; pre-try failures can have fewer receipts. Never synthesize a child status.

Proposed roots and labels are fixed in SOURCE-INPUTS.json: controller-custody-fake10-author01 / controller-custody-fake01 and controller-custody-fake10-confirmation01 / controller-custody-confirmation01. Preserve all 11 child bytes and fourteen non-launcher parent entries. The confirmation launcher changes only the donor-pattern five label literals; recompute its row, PINS and false template. Retain exact before copies and complete reconstructible deltas for review.

Root must separately review the completed instrument and copies before admission. Later invocation uses the same C:\\Python314\\python.exe -I -S -B and lexical IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE before the outer host starts. Preserve actual outer/poll objects, child status, ordered case/subtest objects, ten guards, trap counts, denials and original/copied control checks. A possible pass supports this controller-only unit. Full latest generated-start compatibility, child transport/namespace, real engine, PCM, native/model and release qualification remain separate.

Read evidence is recorded in READ-COVERAGE.json and five complete actual tool objects. No candidate was imported, compiled or executed during this plan. Final instrument hashes remain pending; this plan does not authorize preparation or invocation.
